contacts_reachable_check.name: contacts_reachable_check
contacts_reachable_check.value: "contacts"."email" is not null or "contacts"."phone" is not null

locations_org_parent_code_key.name: locations_org_parent_code_key
locations_org_parent_code_key.where: "locations"."code" is not null and "locations"."parent_id" is not null

locations_org_root_code_key.name: locations_org_root_code_key
locations_org_root_code_key.where: "locations"."code" is not null and "locations"."parent_id" is null

stock_movements_has_location_check.name: stock_movements_has_location_check
stock_movements_has_location_check.value: "stock_movements"."from_location_id" is not null or "stock_movements"."to_location_id" is not null

stock_movements_distinct_locations_check.name: stock_movements_distinct_locations_check
stock_movements_distinct_locations_check.value: "stock_movements"."from_location_id" is null or "stock_movements"."to_location_id" is null or "stock_movements"."from_location_id" <> "stock_movements"."to_location_id"

stock_movements_adjustment_note_check.name: stock_movements_adjustment_note_check
stock_movements_adjustment_note_check.value: "stock_movements"."reason" <> 'adjustment' or ("stock_movements"."note" is not null and length(btrim("stock_movements"."note")) > 0)
